verdict.rationale: Riskified's developer docs have a dedicated SDK reference page stating it provides SDKs for several languages to simplify API integration. A mobile Beacon SDK for Android is also documented, so a developer can build against official SDKs. missing for 10: named list of supported languages, SDK package/repository and versioning details, SDK-specific usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Riskified provides SDKs for several languages to simplify API integration.
Beacon for Android functions similarly to the Beacon for Web JavaScript integration
